title: Evolution Part Two: Adaptation Rate and the Red Queen Effect
heading: Evolution Part Two: Adaptation Rate and the Red Queen Effect
supportSummary: Adaptation rate explains that surviving systems must change quickly enough to match changing conditions.
The Red Queen effect highlights that improvement is relative because rivals and environments also keep moving.
Strong judgment measures pace of adaptation, not just current position.
